notes: Shopify site, reached directly (plain HTTP GET, HTTP 200, no proxy/impersonation needed), matching prior Home-Decor pass notes. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Main nav (Furniture / Decor mega-menus, What's New, brand pages) carries no top-level 'Best Sellers' link, so discovery was via sitemap_collections_1.xml (scanned for best/top-sell/popular/favorite/trending) plus direct URL probing. Found a rich but currently unlinked Bestsellers taxonomy: /collections/best-sellers (a 35-item cross-category flagship list, qty verified by both the rendered ProductCountDesktop header and independent exhaustive /products.json?limit=250 enumeration - both =35) and /collections/best-sellers-furniture (118 items, group parent) with 9 real child listings by furniture type/room (sofas, chairs, tables, storage, living-room, dining-room, bedroom, office, outdoor - all independently qty-verified header==exhaustion). Confirmed genuine sub-structure, not a facet/metafield artifact: furniture-family and decor/canvas-art sets are essentially disjoint from each other (furn&decor=0, furn&art=0), each is its own real Shopify collection with its own title and ProductCountDesktop header (not a filtered view of one page), unlike the unreliable product_type_category metafield noted in the prior Home-Decor pass. best-sellers-decor (38) and best-sellers-canvas-art (82) are standalone leaves, not children of best-sellers-furniture (0 overlap with furniture set). general 'best-sellers' (35) partially overlaps best-sellers-furniture (12/35), consistent with it being an independent cross-category curated pick, not an alias. Two additional sitemap-only listings use 'Best Sellers' in their title but are clearly dated one-off campaign/catalog pages, not part of the current live taxonomy (not linked from any nav, category, or the other bestseller pages I opened): 'Spring Catalog 2023 Best Sellers' (/collections/spring-catalog-2023-best-sellers, 38 items) and 'Best Sellers Spring Sale' (/collections/best-sellers-2024, 50 items, title mixes Bestsellers with Sale). Both are genuine product listings (not editorial) so recorded per rule, but flagged MANUAL REVIEW since it is unclear whether they represent the current active Bestsellers merchandising concept or stale artifacts from a 2023/2024 seasonal push. Checked footer (no Sale/Bestsellers section) and site search (not useful here - all candidates came from sitemap+direct probing). All qty values independently verified two ways: rendered 'N products' header AND exhaustive unique-product-ID count via /collections//products.json?limit=250&page=N to exhaustion - every value matched exactly.
